newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pemex to start up crude sweetner plants.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pemex to start up crude sweetner plants.

text.p: Mexico's state-owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) detailed Thursday its plans to bring on line two crude sweetner plants.

In a statement, Pemex said two new sweetner complexes will start up soon in Pemex City and Nuevo Pemex, both with a capacity to process 24,000 bpd. The first is expected to start operations this month and the second in April next year.
Both plants, previously announced in Pemex's investment schedules, have been constructed to process additional volumes the company is producing through its exploration and production unit.
